About the internship

Selected intern's day-to-day responsibilities include:

1.Roles & Responsibilities
Assist the KAM team in managing existing client accounts.
Coordinate with clients regarding daily logistics requirements.
Follow up on vehicle placement, shipment status, and delivery updates.
Maintain daily reports, client records, and operational data.
Coordinate with internal operations teams to resolve client queries.
Support the team in preparing quotations and business reports.
Ensure timely communication and customer satisfaction.
Assist in handling client complaints and operational issues.

Key Account Management
